body:
### Summary

Following the eMudhra CA compromise, I am thinking it would be handy to have a command to quickly scan uv's managed Python versions for vulns.

Not sure what the best interface would look like. Maybe a new command, e.g. `uv python audit`, analogous to `uv tool audit` to audit currently installed. Maybe it would default to auditing the current interpreter on the project, and then there could be `--all` to audit all installed versions. Maybe it would have `--default` to audit the version which has been installed as the default via `uv python install --default`.

Another possibility is to include the project's current Python version from `.python-version` as a part of advisories in `uv audit`. I think this is probably a bad idea, because it might break e.g. some JSON workflows which assume everything is a _package_.

Loosely related to #8217
